newsitem.title: USA: RESEARCH ALERT-U S West raised to buy.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-U S West raised to buy.

text.p: -- Dillon Read & Co Inc telecommunications analyst William Vogel raised his rating of U S West Communications to a buy on Wednesday, giving the stock a $36 price target over the next twelve to eighteen months.

-- In a research report, Vogel said the company has shown improved held orders, customer access to service representatives, and repair intervals. Currently, the stock is valued to reflect a worst case outcome for U S West, he said.
-- Strong quality could also give the company a stronger bargaining posiitions with state regulators in control of regulatory reform, he said.
